type:
∀ {τ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K]
  {U' U : MvPolynomial τ K} {V' : Polynomial K} {F : MvPolynomial (Option τ) K} {g : K},
  g ≠ 0 →
    U = g • U' →
      F = (rename some) U' * (Polynomial.aeval (X none)) V' →
        F = (rename some) U * (Polynomial.aeval (X none)) (Polynomial.C g⁻¹ * V')
